description: Verso: Colophon with an embellished signature by the scribe Yehosef b. Ṣedaqa. Written on Monday, 1 Elul. There are writing exercises in Arabic in a chancery hand reading "thiqat al-mulk dhū l-riʾāsa ṣanīʿat amīr al-muʾminīn" and a similar phrase on the facing page. The facing page also includes an unfinished note in Judaeo-Arabic: "I learned that the bearer of this note is a Muslim man who knows that the lofty presence. . . " (אתצל בי אן מוצל הדה אלרקעה רגל מסלם יערף באן חצרתה אלסאמיה)
description_he: טקסט פרא-ספרותי בArabic, Hebrew, Judaeo-Arabic. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
